summary: Live app (v23) has a blocking production issue: header and My Profile are not rendering user data due to a Firestore data-binding/data-source mismatch; must read strictly from Firestore users/{uid} and bind to existing field names without touching auth/signup/login/admin or changing UI layout.
architectural_notes: User profile display must read user data ONLY from Firestore at users/{uid} (not Firebase Auth) for Header + My Profile.
Do NOT rename/mutate stored Firestore user document fields; UI bindings must match existing Firestore field names.
Scope constraint: do not touch signup page, login page, or admin dashboard; fix only Header avatar/name and My Profile (photo/name/email).
known_issues: Blocking (v23 prod): Profile photo, full name, email not rendering on My Profile; header avatar not rendering; header name changed incorrectly (likely data-source/binding mismatch).

existing_features.title: Ensure the My Profile screen renders the logged-in user’s profile photo, full name, and email address by reading ONLY from Firestore document path `users/{auth.uid}` and binding ONLY to the existing Firestore field names `photoURL`, `name`, and `email` (no reads from Firebase Auth user fields for display).

On the My Profile screen, implement a deterministic avatar fallback based strictly on Firestore: if `users/{uid}.photoURL` is missing/empty/whitespace, do not render an image URL and instead render initials derived from `users/{uid}.name`.

Fix the header’s top-right avatar and displayed header/profile-menu name so they render from Firestore `users/{uid}` only: use `photoURL` for the avatar image when present; otherwise show initials derived from Firestore `name`, and ensure the displayed name in the header/profile menu is exactly Firestore `name` (undo any incorrect name source/binding).

Verify the Firestore read is performed against the exact document path `users/{auth.uid}` with an awaited fresh server read (no cache) so UI reliably updates based on existing Firestore data; add/keep console logs sufficient to confirm the UID used and that the read is not from cache.

new_feature_requests.summary: Fix production data-binding so Header (avatar/name) and My Profile (photo/full name/email) render correctly by reading ONLY from Firestore users/{uid} using existing field names; do not modify stored data or touch signup/login/admin.

projectName: Fix header + My Profile rendering by binding strictly to Firestore users/{uid} fields
